_instructions: Session task list texts. snapshot_heading opens the list in the instructions ({revision} is the list's revision when the snapshot was made); snapshot_rule follows it; snapshot_empty replaces the sections when there are none. step_line opens the one-line task state in each step's guidance message ({sections} lists each open section, its active step and its next open step); fold_hint follows it while a section with steps has not started and another section is closed ({section} is its id). user_change_heading opens each change the user made from the chat's task panel, which the agent receives with its next model call. Before a tool call the app files unfiled user requests itself (on the newest open section, or a new section titled from the request); that change reaches the agent under gate_change_heading. Requests answered without tool work are set aside when the turn ends, silently. Edited in place; no compile.
snapshot_heading: Session tasks: this session's working list, as of revision {revision}; it ends with the session. It is always current here, so never call task_list_read for it. Keep steps for multi-step work with task_list_write, in the same model step as your other tool calls.
snapshot_rule: If another session or a later day would need something, it belongs in Main Notes; a step of the work in front of you belongs here.
fold_hint: Before starting {section}: if it does not need the details of the closed work, set fold_earlier on the task_list_write that starts its first step.
user_change_heading: The user changed the session task list (revision {revision}):
gate_change_heading: The app filed your user requests in the session task list (revision {revision}). If a request belongs in a different or new section, or needs steps, change it in your next task_list_write alongside your next tool calls:
